subject: general
question:
The following bar graph gives figures for the production of fans and of coolers by a large company in four consecutive years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48d6ebd4b5bbd49f0ffc286e6c81cead51ff1aeb7d85fad70816f3c435b6d188.png] 

Calculate the ratio of the number of fans produced in 1998 to the number of coolers produced in 2001.
solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph representing the production of fans and coolers by a large company from year 1998 to 2001.

**Calculations:**

No. of fans produced in year 1998 is 23.

No. of coolers produced in year 2001 is 18

Now, the ratio = 23 ∶ 18

**Hence, The Required ratio is 23 ∶ 18.**
